deadline.value: Apply by February 1, 2027 (same date for US and non-US applicants).

gre_general.value: The admissions listing marks GRE scores optional, although the department says successful applicants have high GRE scores.

also.quote: Successful applicants will have high scores on the GRE test (especially the quantitative score)

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor of science degree with at least a 3.0 GPA (preferably above 3.2).
entry_route.quote: All applicants should have a bachelor of science degree from an accredited college with at least a 3.0 undergraduate GPA (preferably >3.2).
